t: Forge Steel chalk line is an essential marking tool for efficiently creating accurate straight lines across various surfaces. Ideal for construction, carpentry and general marking tasks where precision is paramount. The robust chalk line features a durable ABS plastic construction for longevity on site, and a generous 30 metre line length to cover extensive areas. Its 55g chalk capacity allows for prolonged use between refills, complemented by a strong metal hook for secure attachment, ensuring reliable performance during demanding work. Chalk available separately.
